title: Delhi HC asks MCD to hike fine for throwing garbage in drains, laments lack of civic sense among Indians
description: The Delhi High Court on Tuesday lamented that a lack of civic sense among people was leading to clogging of drains and water logging during monsoons.A Bench of Justices Prathiba Singh and Manmeet Pritam Singh Arora remarked that smaller countries with heavy rains like Vietnam have been able to prevent such issues.“How are the small countries doing it? She (lawyer) mentioned Vietnam. Why is this happening? This has to be coordinated with civic sense of the citizens,” the Court remarked.The Court
